title: Articles 29–30 — Cultural and educational rights (subject provision)

content.heading: Cultural and educational rights
content.text: Article 29 protects minority interests in language, script and culture and bars denial of admission on specified grounds in State-maintained or State-aided educational institutions. Article 30 entitles religious and linguistic minorities to establish and administer educational institutions of their choice. Canonical: provision:india:constitution-art-29, art-30.
